policy.principle: Counter-evidence registry v0.1 requires hypotheses to be challenged before any mechanism can be validated.

counter_evidence_reviews.hypothesis_statement: Policy and regulatory changes affect industrial outcomes through cost, incentive, compliance, or capacity-support channels.
known_support_evidence: Hypothesis originates from a principle candidate that passed coverage and diversity screening.
counter_evidence_search_questions: Where did the expected mechanism fail?
Where did the opposite mechanism occur?
Where did another driver explain the outcome better?
Where was evidence mixed or ambiguous?
Could the same evidence support both pro and contra interpretations?
Are there high-authority sources that weaken the hypothesis?

governance.note: This registry creates the counter-evidence review layer. It does not validate mechanisms or approve conclusions.
